_comment: The inputs the placement, leak and end-to-end gates render with. Acme is
not a real site and never becomes one: this tree is placed into a temp
directory, asserted against, and deleted. The values are chosen to be
AWKWARD rather than tidy — a site name with an apostrophe and an
ampersand (both legal in the card's pattern, both special in HTML,
TypeScript strings, shell words and JSON), a hyphenated repo slug that
ENDS in the baseline's own slug (so its Worker is `<…>-cms-wordpress-web`),
an owner other than the baseline's, and NO domain — a console build asks
for none, so the placeholder <reponame>.example.com is what a site is
born with, and this slug's placeholder CONTAINS the baseline's own
placeholder domain — because a fixture that only uses values the
templates were written against proves the templates work on the values
Every key here is an input repo-blueprint.yaml declares. A key it does not
declare is a fixture that has drifted, and orun refuses it.
